responsibility: Implements the markdown parser and normalization pipeline for rustc diagnostics. It scans input text into `MdTree` nodes, handles inline and block markdown forms such as headings, code, lists, comments, and links, resolves reference links from link definitions, and rewrites plain text/newline structure into the paragraph and line-break form expected by terminal rendering.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `markdown/tests/parse.rs`, which only asserts expected parser behavior in test cases, this file contains the production markdown parser and normalization logic itself, including token recognition, recursive parsing, reference-link resolution, and paragraph/line-break rewriting.
